_doc: Tiered / usage subscriptions for ledger_profile.py (owner answer 2026-10-10 19:38: Claude Pro / Max 5x / Max 20x switching plus API usage under one merchant). One service = one merchant key (ledger_profile.merchant_key). A charge is a PLAN charge when its KRW amount sits in a tier band [lo, hi] and, when plan_words is set, its descriptor (letters only, casefolded) carries one of them; every other charge of the merchant is USAGE (regular spending under usage_name). Bands are KRW including VAT: krw = usd x (1 + vat) x fx, lo / hi = krw x (1 -/+ tolerance), rounded to 100 won. Generic: add a service with its own table; code reads only key, name, usage_name, plan_words, tiers[].tier/lo/hi.
